inherits.rule: UAK0 routes D01-D19, UAK1 outcome U02, layers L1/L3/LC and routes K01-K04, and VID0 identities I03/I05 and routes V-D01-V-D06 keep their owners. CPF0 references them by id and adds no second owner. CPF0 adds carrier-compiler methods M01-M23, products P01-P17, contracts T01-T03, capability rows CR01-CR06, outcomes F-O01-F-O07, consumers F-C01-F-C14 and displaced routes F-D01-F-D08, and maps each charter deletion category to its recorded and referenced routes (categoryCoverage).

ownerRoles.owner: Implementation owner: the one production-capable DAG node whose charter accepts the production migration or deletion of the row, bound by successorPath and receivingAcceptance.
ownerRoles.contractOwner: Contract owner, present only where it differs from owner: the docs-only node that defines the named boundary the row consumes (contractAcceptance). A contract owner never substitutes for the implementation owner: a node with zero production scope cannot receive a production migration.
ownerRoles.receivingCharterAmendment: Present when the implementation owner's charter does not yet cover every path of the row; names the receivingCharterAmendments entry that must be ratified into that charter before it dispatches.

classes.frontend: Carrier profile product: bytes, parse, recovery, registered geometry, parse diagnostics, parse admission, carrier grammar fact. Present for every carrier. Layer L3 (frontend half); imports no LC module.
classes.semantic: Semantic (framework) profile product over an admitted parse: eval source, template facts, style meaning. Optional per profile; tooling consumes it; imports no LC module.
classes.projection: Optional tooling product: IDE companion, public API, declarations, with their maps. Never required by a runtime demand; never requires a compiler backend.
classes.compiler-backend: Optional compiler product: runtime client/server bytes, runtime maps, runtime diagnostics, compile admission and grants, bundle orchestration, compile artifact set. Present only for compile-capable carriers. Layer LC.
classes.residue: Combined-compiler residue with no successor: deleted, never re-homed.

emptyPopulations.unit: A combined CarrierCompiler trait or dynamic compiler registry
emptyPopulations.evidence: No CarrierCompiler trait exists; capability.rs already defines CarrierFrontend, FrameworkSemanticAuthority, ProjectionBackend, RuntimeCompilerBackend and FrameworkHostIntegrationBackend as separate traits (UAK0 empty population).
emptyPopulations.consequence: The compiler-shaped residue is the two unit structs (F-D02), their test-support shims (F-D03) and the closed enums (UAK0 D02). CPF1 subblock 6 deletes those.

emptyPopulations.unit: Host and transport callers of a combined compile entry
emptyPopulations.evidence: No production caller of compile_bundle, compile_ide, compile_runtime, project_ide or CarrierFrontend::parse exists in verter_session, verter_lsp, NAPI, WASM, FFI, MCP or unplugin. NAPI, WASM and FFI do name the compile-request envelope in production (P17, F-C12): CompileRequest, CompileRequestError, ProductKind, FrameworkOption, RuntimeStyleProcessing, VueOption and the vue and svelte request modules. MCP names none of those Rust symbols. unplugin names the JS HostCompileRequest wire only. The external-corpus binary parse_corpus_probe is a compiler-bin consumer of parse_registered_frontend (F-C11), not a host or transport caller. Production session compile still enters through compile_host_products, compile_runtime_render and the Vue audit route (F-D07). StandaloneCompiler::compile and prepare in standalone.rs re-parse through parse_sfc and parse_svelte and never enter CarrierFrontend::parse (F-C13). verter-tsc checker.rs generate_all_tsx, reached from pub fn run, is the production driver of that compile and names the compile-request envelope (F-C14).
emptyPopulations.consequence: No host or transport consumer of a combined compile entry migrates beyond F-C01-F-C10. The envelope's transport consumers are F-C12 (CMP0). The probe is F-C11 (CPF1). The direct-compile surface is F-C13 (CPF1). The verter-tsc envelope consumer is F-C14 (CMP0).

emptyPopulations.evidence: No RuntimeCompilerBackend or FrameworkHostIntegrationBackend implementation returns Unsupported for a whole carrier; absence is already type-level (Present versus an omitted registration; compile-fail frontend_only_has_no_runtime_accessor, projection_only_has_no_runtime_accessor).
emptyPopulations.consequence: Nothing to delete; T03 forbids adding one.

findings: Production routes do not consult the frontend rows through VueCarrierFrontend directly: registered_carrier_projection selects the frontend row and then rebuilds a KnownRegisteredCompiler from it, so the catalog row and the compiler struct are two identities for one carrier (F-D02, D02).

The semantic and projection catalogs already dispatch through function-pointer rows with no Vue/Svelte match; the frontend, host-integration and runtime catalogs still use closed enums (D02). The function-pointer shape is the existing precedent for the two new registries.
registered_host_integration_for has no production caller; verter_session native_host_binding re-scans built_in_host_integration_catalog itself (D02, D03).

Registry backend and projection rows already consume the one admitted FrameworkParseArtifact through M05/M15, and lower_vue_from_parsed / lower_svelte_from_parsed do the same. StandaloneCompiler::compile and prepare do not: they call parse_sfc and parse_svelte (F-C13). Their successor consumes that admitted parse, so separation does not require a second artifact and the charter abort condition does not trigger.

receivingCharterAmendments.obligation: Migrate every production constructor and consumer of the compile-request envelope (P17) onto the typed CompileRequest and CompilerPolicy admission route that CMP0 defines, in the same change that makes that route the sole production admission route (CMP1 compatibility closure), so no transport or verter-tsc caller keeps the retained mixed request/policy conversion.
receivingCharterAmendments.amendment: Add these paths to CMP1's production surfaces and write scope for the envelope-consumer migration only. CMP1's current boundary is crates/verter_compiler/src and crates/verter_semantic/src with write scope compile_request/demand/** and compiler_view/**, which does not cover them.
receivingCharterAmendments.why: CMP0 is docs-only (zero production LOC) and keeps the contract. CMP1 is the first production node on the CPF0 -> CMP0 path that changes the envelope's admission route, so it is the node whose change forces every constructor to migrate.
